_note: Filled once for the whole company. VERIFY every value before the first product.

hosting.web: cloudflare-workers static assets (apps/web/out served by apps/api Worker)
hosting.api: cloudflare-workers (Hono) + D1/KV; R2 only at maturity Level 3
hosting.mobile: expo eas (free) or local gradle builds
hosting.platform: equisteg-platform Worker (shared payments/entitlement) via service binding

payments.web: razorpay (India) or stripe — hosted checkout, test mode until Gate 9
payments.signup: none — licence key + email magic link restore

costPolicy: zero-cost: free tiers or open source only; see docs/standards/zero-cost.md

domains.pattern: each product has its own domain (apex, www redirects); dev/staging on *.workers.dev
domains.registrar: Cloudflare Registrar in the company (Equisteg) account, registrant org Equisteg, auto-renew on — bought by a founder
domains.emailFrom: no-reply@equisteg.com via Resend (free plan verifies 3 domains — never one per product)
domains.supportEmail: support@<domain> via Cloudflare Email Routing → developerEmail
domains.attribution: own product name/logo + 'A product by Equisteg' (footer, About, app About); Equisteg is the legal entity and JSON-LD publisher
